OfficeCategory.OFFICE_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION: The legislative powers of the town council are identical to those of the city common council. In addition, town councils exercise administrative authority in their municipalities. Council vacancies are filled by a caucus of the precinct committeemen of the same party as the person vacating the office. If the vacated council seat was held by an independent, or if the appropriate political party fails to fill the vacancy within a 30 day period, then the vacancy is filled by a vote of the remaining council members.
